coverage: All twenty-nine scenes in both original-en and modern-en: named cast, speaking and stage roles, the crowd and army groups, the Martian genealogy of the Senate’s praise, and the classical figures named in the play.

entities.name: Caius Martius
entities.body: A Roman patrician and the city’s foremost soldier, hated by the plebeians for his contempt of them.

snapshots.body: Caius Martius, given the name Coriolanus by the army for taking the town of Corioles single-handed.
Caius Martius Coriolanus, banished from Rome by the voices of the people.

entities.name: Menenius Agrippa
entities.body: An old patrician, a friend to Caius Martius and well liked by the people.

entities.name: Sicinius Velutus
entities.body: One of the two tribunes newly given to the people.

entities.name: Junius Brutus
entities.body: The other of the two tribunes newly given to the people.

entities.name: Cominius
entities.body: The Roman general and consul who commands against the Volsces.

entities.name: Volumnia
entities.body: Caius Martius’s mother, who raised him to the wars.

entities.name: Tullus Aufidius
entities.body: The Volscian general, and Caius Martius’s chief enemy in the field.

entities.name: Virgilia
entities.body: Caius Martius’s wife.

entities.name: Titus Lartius
entities.body: A Roman general who serves with Cominius against the Volsces.

entities.name: Valeria
entities.body: A Roman lady, friend to Virgilia and Volumnia, and sister to Publicola.

entities.name: Young Martius
entities.body: Caius Martius and Virgilia’s young son.

entities.name: The First Citizen
entities.body: The plebeian who leads the corn riot and speaks for the crowd.

entities.name: The Second Citizen
entities.body: A plebeian in the corn riot, readier than the first to hear Menenius out.

entities.name: The Third Citizen
entities.body: A plebeian who speaks in the market-place when the voices are asked for.

entities.name: The Fourth Citizen
entities.body: A plebeian in the market-place crowd.

entities.name: The citizen
entities.body: A plebeian who speaks alone in the crowd.

entities.name: The First Senator
entities.body: A senator of Rome, and in the Volscian scenes a senator of Corioles.

entities.name: The Second Senator
entities.body: A second senator speaking in council.

entities.name: The First Servingman
entities.body: A servingman in Aufidius’s house at Antium.

entities.name: The Second Servingman
entities.body: A servingman in Aufidius’s house at Antium.

entities.name: The Third Servingman
entities.body: A servingman in Aufidius’s house at Antium.

entities.name: The First Watch
entities.body: A Volscian sentry before the camp, who turns Menenius away.

entities.name: The Second Watch
entities.body: A Volscian sentry before the camp.

entities.name: Nicanor
entities.body: The Roman who sells his city’s news to the Volsces.

entities.name: Adrian
entities.body: The Volscian agent who meets Nicanor on the road.

entities.name: The Aedile
entities.body: The tribunes’ officer, who musters the people for them.

entities.name: The First Soldier
entities.body: A soldier in the Roman army before Corioles.

entities.name: The soldier
entities.body: A soldier who directs Menenius to Aufidius’s camp.

entities.name: The Lieutenant
entities.body: Aufidius’s lieutenant, uneasy at how far Coriolanus has eclipsed him.

entities.name: The First Officer
entities.body: An officer laying cushions in the Capitol.

entities.name: The Second Officer
entities.body: The other officer laying cushions in the Capitol.

entities.name: The messenger
entities.body: A messenger carrying news between Rome and the field.

entities.name: The Second Messenger
entities.body: A second messenger arriving with news.

entities.name: The First Lord
entities.body: A lord of Corioles at the last hearing.

entities.name: The Second Lord
entities.body: A lord of Corioles at the last hearing.

entities.name: The Third Lord
entities.body: A lord of Corioles at the last hearing.

entities.name: The First Conspirator
entities.body: One of the men Aufidius takes into his plot.

entities.name: The Second Conspirator
entities.body: One of the men Aufidius takes into his plot.

entities.name: The Third Conspirator
entities.body: One of the men Aufidius takes into his plot.

entities.name: The Herald
entities.body: The herald who proclaims Coriolanus’s new name in Rome.

entities.name: The Usher
entities.body: The usher attending Valeria.

entities.name: Virgilia’s gentlewoman
entities.body: The gentlewoman who brings Virgilia word that Valeria has come.

entities.name: Valeria’s gentlewoman
entities.body: The gentlewoman who comes in attending Valeria.

entities.name: The plebeians
entities.body: The common people of Rome.

entities.name: The patricians
entities.body: The noble families of Rome.

entities.name: The senators
entities.body: The senators of Rome, and of Corioles in the Volscian scenes.

entities.name: The tribunes
entities.body: Sicinius and Brutus, the two tribunes of the people, speaking together.

entities.name: The aediles
entities.body: The tribunes’ officers.

entities.name: The lictors
entities.body: The officers who go before the consul.

entities.name: The citizens
entities.body: The citizens of Rome in the streets and the market-place.

entities.name: The soldiers
entities.body: The soldiers of the Roman and Volscian armies.

entities.name: The conspirators
entities.body: The men who join Aufidius against Coriolanus.

entities.name: The servingmen
entities.body: The servingmen of Aufidius’s household.

entities.name: The attendants
entities.body: The attendants at the Roman houses and the Capitol.

entities.name: The captains
entities.body: The captains of the Roman army.

entities.name: The guard
entities.body: The guard at Aufidius’s camp.

entities.name: The Volsces
entities.body: The Volscian people, Rome’s enemies in this war.

entities.name: The Antiates
entities.body: The people of Antium, Aufidius’s city.

entities.name: The house of the Martians
entities.body: The Roman family Caius Martius comes of, which the Senate’s praise traces back to the kings.

entities.name: Cotus
entities.body: A servingman of Aufidius’s house, called for by name but never brought on.

entities.name: Publicola
entities.body: Valeria’s brother, named once in Coriolanus’s praise of her.

entities.name: Ancus Martius
entities.body: A king of Rome of the Martian house, Numa’s daughter’s son.

entities.name: Numa
entities.body: An early king of Rome, grandfather of Ancus Martius.

entities.name: Hostilius
entities.body: An early king of Rome, who reigned after Ancus Martius.

entities.name: Publius
entities.body: A Roman of the Martian house who brought the city its water.

entities.name: Quintus
entities.body: A Roman of the Martian house who brought the city its water.

entities.name: Censorinus
entities.body: A Roman of the Martian house, twice censor, and surnamed for it.

entities.name: Marcus
entities.body: A Volscian killed in the war, named by his cousin in the crowd at Corioles.

entities.name: Hob and Dick
entities.body: Two common names Coriolanus throws out for ordinary citizens at large, not two men of the play.

entities.name: Tarquin
entities.body: The last king of Rome, driven out before the play begins.

entities.name: Cato
entities.body: The Roman byword for the soldier’s virtues, in Titus Lartius’s praise.

entities.name: Alexander
entities.body: Alexander the Great, in the Third Servingman’s picture of Coriolanus enthroned.

entities.name: Galen
entities.body: The Greek physician, whose authority Menenius mocks.

entities.name: Lycurgus
entities.body: The Spartan lawgiver; Menenius mocks the tribunes as so many Lycurguses.

entities.name: Ulysses
entities.body: The Greek hero of Ithaca, whose wife Penelope is named beside him.

entities.name: Penelope
entities.body: Ulysses’ wife, who unwove her web to put off her suitors.

entities.name: Hector
entities.body: The great defender of Troy.

entities.name: Hecuba
entities.body: Hector’s mother, whose breasts Volumnia says were no lovelier than Hector’s forehead bleeding.

entities.name: Hercules
entities.body: The strongest of the Greek heroes.

entities.name: Deucalion
entities.body: The survivor of the flood in Greek myth, a byword for the remotest ancestry.

entities.name: Jupiter
entities.body: The king of the gods, also called Jove.

entities.name: Juno
entities.body: The queen of the gods.

entities.name: Mars
entities.body: The god of war, whom Cominius names as Coriolanus’s measure.

entities.name: Neptune
entities.body: The god of the sea.

entities.name: Phoebus
entities.body: The sun god.

entities.name: Diana
entities.body: The chaste goddess and huntress.

entities.name: Pluto
entities.body: The god of the underworld.

entities.name: Triton
entities.body: The sea god who blows the horn; Coriolanus calls Sicinius a Triton of the minnows.

entities.name: Hydra
entities.body: The many-headed monster, Coriolanus’s figure for the people.

entities.name: Olympus
entities.body: The mountain of the gods, set against a molehill in Coriolanus’s scorn.
